simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תְּחוֹת (H8460) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: prep.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תְּחוֹת (tᵉchôwth) means beneath First listed occurrence: Dan 4 9.

definitions.full: H8460. techoth תְּחוֺת preposition under (Biblical Hebrew תַּחַתּ ; תְּחוֺת ᵑ7 , Syriac , , adverb ; Palmyrene לתחת מן Cooke 320 ); — Dan 7:27 כָּלשְֿׁמַיָּא תְּחוֺת (compare Biblical Hebrew II. 1 ); in plural with suffix (as Biblical Hebrew, Syriac, ᵑ7 ) 4:9 תְּחֹתֹהִי (so ᵑ7 Onk Lev 15:10 : Dalm § 47, 2 ), 15:18 . With מִן , Jer 10:11 שְׁמַיָּא תְּחוֺת מִן (compare Biblical Hebrew III. 2 ); suffix Dan 4:11 מִןתַּֿחְתּוֺהִי (the form as Syriac adverb above, unless a Hebraizing punct.).
